## bio

Raised C.O.G.I.C.! Started playing with the auxiliary percussion with the band at Ezekiel Temple, then drums, then bass guitar, then producing & eventually being blessed with an SP-404 A by a brother in the faith.

Only child to Minister Wells W. Jamison & Antoinette Jamison, who served at Ezekiel Temple C.O.G.I.C.

I was a goof who didn't have rhythm yet. However, they did allow me to play bongos & auxiliary percussion; that was a blessing!

From there, I took drum lessons, joined concert band, corps-style drumline, started playing bass guitar with bands around STL.

Music will take you on a journey!

Each song is a timestamp from a different season of my life. These audio imprints are reminders of just how much God has been with me every step of the way.

In 2020, I started pursuing music full-time. I started a music company, Matthew Jamison Music, LLC, and entered a couple of sync-libraries.

I quickly learned that a music income wasn't stable enough to provide for a family of 4. I learned to code through a local bootcamp (LaunchCode); now I work on rails apps for a living.

If you didn't know my best friend, wife, and favorite human, Bernie J, is a women's minister at Refresh Community Church; our daughters are 17 y/o & 10 y/o.

I wouldn't be who I am today if it weren't for these beautiful humans.

Immense gratitude for the responsibility and ministry bestowed on me.

## why the beats sound like this

These moments are honestly conversations I was having within myself,
and wrestling with emotions, trauma, and limitations
when I was making each track,
it was as if I wasn't alone in any of it
it felt as if God was giving me ideas as I explored and created in these sandboxes of sound
creation for creation's sake
still healing

- real-time arranging
- available alongside sp-404 a sets or standalone

## gear + rider (sp-404 a)

Input list:
- 2x 1/4" ts outputs from sp-404 a stereo main outs (l + r - no mono summing)
- 1x monitor wedge or iem - stereo mix of sp-404 a output
- 1x standard power outlet at table (sp-404 a can also run on batteries as backup)
- if bass set: 1x di box or 1/4" bass input - 1x monitor for bass mix - confirm at booking

Full stage needs, what Matthew brings, and what he doesn't need are listed on
the site under gear + rider.
